chapters.title: FIRST BOND
chapters.humanCue: W/S sets pace · arrows steer · tap SPACE when Sablewing needs lift
chapters.phasePromise: Learn her weight, not a list of buttons.

win.narrative: Galevein trusts the saddle. The cove is behind you.

hud.goalText: Follow three low wind rings and learn her rhythm
subHints: Feel beat and brake before open water

chapters.storyLine: Rook, breathe with her. Three rings, then the open water.

chapters.title: THREE LIGHTS
chapters.humanCue: Press C to read the fog · fly through all four lighthouse vanes
chapters.phasePromise: Relight a safe road for the fishing coast.
chapters.reward: The drowned coast answers your echo.

win.narrative: The inner road opens. Echo carries farther than fear.

hud.goalText: Echo through the fog and wake the four coastal lights
subHints: Press C to echo — lights reveal the road

chapters.storyLine: Three lighthouses are dark. Give the coast its horizon back.

chapters.title: THE LOST WING
chapters.humanCue: Climb to 120m · find the answering hearth · choose 1 or 2
chapters.phasePromise: Follow a strange echo to a dragon left behind.
chapters.reward: Neris, a young Tidevein, joins your flight.

win.narrative: The canyon spits you onto the cinder coast alive.

hud.goalText: Map the harbor from 120m and answer the Last Hearth
subHints: Canyon gates are optional cover rewards
Beacon eight opens after 120m AGL and a Last Hearth choice

chapters.storyLine: That echo is not a lighthouse. Something alive is calling back.

chapters.title: STORMWAKE PURSUIT
chapters.humanCue: Hold X for a charged lance · break all three wind shrines
chapters.phasePromise: Protect Neris while the Keeper net closes.

win.narrative: The wind shrines fall silent. The bone arches fade behind the rain.

loss.narrative: Night takes the wastes before the gate.

hud.goalText: Shield Neris and silence the three Keeper wind shrines
subHints: Hold X to charge plasma — break Keeper wind shrines
Press F to hide in the flock

chapters.storyLine: Neris is with you. Now the whole storm turns to follow.

chapters.title: CROWN OF THE GALE
chapters.humanCue: Charge X into the Crowned Maw · pass the final vane when it falls
chapters.phasePromise: Face the apex dragon guarding the way home.
chapters.reward: The pair become a flight, not fugitives.

win.narrative: The aurora curtain parts. Galevein carries you through.

loss.narrative: The gate is lost to nightfall.

hud.chapterLabel: Phase V · Crown of the Gale
hud.objectiveTemplate: Face the Crowned Maw — final signal {score}/12
hud.goalText: Bring down the apex dragon and cross the Tempest Gate

chapters.storyLine: The Crowned Maw owns this sky. Tonight, it learns to share it.
chapters.popupOnEnter: PHASE V · CROWN OF THE GALE

metaObjectives.save_dragon: Wake Galevein in the cove and earn her trust through the first rings.
metaObjectives.rebuild: Cross home waters without losing the Codex to reckless violence.
metaObjectives.rescue: Find the spared torch in the drowned village — someone still tends a hearth.
metaObjectives.collect_at_altitude: Climb above harbor masts and cinder stacks to read the coast.
metaObjectives.destroy_tower: Charge plasma (X) and break the Keeper wind shrines reading your wake.
